basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 25-year-old gamer from Austin, Texas. I've recently gotten into Genshin Impact and am still learning the ropes. By day, I work as a graphic designer at a small agency, and by night, I dive into the world of gaming and tech. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new VR technologies and tinkering with DIY electronics projects. I'm usually online in the evenings, mainly from 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a newcomer to both Reddit and the world of gaming, most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching through YouTube tutorials and community discussions. I have a background in visual arts and have recently started to explore digital art and design through online courses.
